name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
summary: An isolation exercise that targets the triceps by extending the elbow from a bent-over torso position.

setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping your back flat and core braced.
Pull your elbows up tight to your ribcage so your upper arms are aligned with your torso.
steps: Keeping your upper arms stationary against your sides, extend your elbows to press the dumbbells backward.
Contract your triceps firmly as your arms reach full extension.
Slowly reverse the movement, controlling the dumbbells back to approximately a 90-degree bend at the elbow.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you extend your arms straight back; inhale as you lower the weights with control.
cues: Pin your elbows to your sides

common_faults.fault: Swinging the upper arm to generate momentum.
common_faults.correction: Lock your upper arms in place parallel to your torso and move strictly at the elbow joint.

common_faults.fault: Dropping the elbows below torso height.
common_faults.correction: Keep your elbows pulled high and tight throughout the entire repetition.

precautions: Maintain a neutral spine during the hip hinge to avoid lower back strain.
